_comment: Shipped third-party content that is NOT a Gradle or npm dependency: fonts, the bundled Java runtime,
native binaries inside a dependency jar whose POM names only the packaging license. Listed in the
notices and the SBOM. 'files' are repository globs; every font file under a module's src/ must be
covered by an entry here or the check fails. 'verify': 'font-name-table' reads the font's own
license record (OpenType name ID 13); 'license-file' requires 'licenseFile' to carry the license.

components.name: Inter (font)
components.note: UI font of the till (APK, Linux client, /pos browser till) and of generated PDF documents (server).

components.name: Noto Sans SC, GB2312 subset (font)
components.copyright: Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'
components.note: Served by pos-server at /font for the web admin panel's Chinese UI; the subset drops the font's own license record, so the OFL text ships beside it.

components.name: Java runtime (Eclipse Temurin 21, jlinked)
components.copyright: Copyright Oracle and/or its affiliates and the Eclipse Adoptium contributors
components.note: The server package's jre/ folder is a jlink image of the build JDK (Eclipse Temurin 21 in the release workflow), as is the runtime inside the Linux .deb. Its own legal notices are in jre/legal/.

components.name: PostgreSQL server binaries (inside io.zonky.test.postgres:embedded-postgres-binaries-linux-amd64)
components.copyright: Portions Copyright (c) 1996-2024, The PostgreSQL Global Development Group; Portions Copyright (c) 1994, The Regents of the University of California
components.note: The embedded database. The Maven artifact is Apache-2.0 packaging; the PostgreSQL binaries it carries are under the PostgreSQL License.

components.name: Alpine.js
components.note: Vendored, unmodified cdn.min.js (sha256 232519394c6c8fdba6f362b1d9da16106db513cdbf899011f00daab4051df31c). Drives the maintainer log-search page at /maintenance/; no CDN, because shops often run offline.
